name: Ghost Ring
body:
Aura strong transmutation; CL 13th; Slot ring; Price 36,400 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring is made of silver and crystal. Upon putting on the ring, it becomes translucent and is difficult to spot on the wearer’s finger (DC 20 Perception check).

On command, and for up to 10 rounds per day, the wearer becomes incorporeal and is able to walk through solid matter. Measures taken which prevent ethereal creatures from passing through an item or area prevent the wearer from passing through them as well. The rounds of use do not need to be consecutive.

If the wearer becomes corporeal while passing through solid matter, she is expelled to the closest unoccupied space and suffers 1d6 damage for every 5 feet through which she passes.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells ethereal jaunt; Cost 18,200 gp

Identification DC 28
